channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Birthright citizenship is in the Constitution plain as day
item.description: As the Supreme Court takes up Trump v. Barbara, a “blatantly unconstitutional” bid to end birthright citizenship tests whether the 14th Amendment’s clear promise still protects millions.

item.title: Can we talk about the transfer portal?
item.description: From the transfer portal and NIL money to year-round youth leagues, Lib Campbell examines how modern sports culture strains families, reshapes education and risks burning out young athletes.

item.title: How will independent voters turn in 2026?
item.description: In North Carolina, unaffiliated voters now outnumber both parties and currently tilt Democratic for 2026, as Roy Cooper’s strength and Trump fatigue give Democrats a tentative edge with crucial swing voters.

item.title: Child care crisis contributes to shrinking families
item.description: Skyrocketing child care costs and scarce programs in North Carolina are shrinking family size, sidelining parents from work and prompting calls for Missouri-style subsidies and after-school support.

item.title: Jetstream traffic signal to go live Tuesday
item.description: A new traffic signal at Airport Boulevard and Jetstream Drive goes live Tuesday after safety concerns prompted NCDOT to install the light.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 3-4, 2026
item.description: Area sports for Jan. 3–4: Saturday is packed with high school basketball, with varsity and JV boys and girls games at Wilson Prep and St. David’s; Sunday has no events scheduled.

item.title: WPA girls blitz Jacksonville in New Year’s Showcase
item.description: Wilson Prep girls open 2026 at home with an 80-52 rout of Jacksonville, fueled by Paris Best’s 27 points, as a brutal early schedule and key transfers sharpen their 1-A title push.

item.title: Tigers tame Tarboro to end skid
item.description: Wilson Prep ends a three-game skid with a foul-heavy 73-66 win over Tarboro at its New Year’s Showcase, as the young Tigers overcome free-throw woes behind balanced scoring.

item.title: From Tobs glory to Wilson Prep’s walk-off kick—the unforgettable local sports moments of 2025
item.description: From Wilson Tobs’ storybook title and relocation to Wilson Prep’s last-second football crown, 2025 delivered rare championships, emotional farewells and big changes across the local sports scene.

item.title: “He knew what to do’: Teen saves older brother’s life
item.description: A Wilson County 14-year-old used CPR training he received at school to save his older brother after a seizure left him face down in a remote swamp during a duck hunt, family says.
